sentences.text:
Ranjit Saha vs Unknown on 9 June, 2023
09.06.2023 C.R.M. (A) 1599 of 2023
 Sl. 7
Court No. 29 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of
 Sourav the Code of Criminal Procedure filed in connection with G.R Case
 (Allowed)
 No. 716 of 2023 pending before the Chief Judicial Magistrate,
 Malda, arising out of Mothabari Police Station Case No. 35 of
 2023 dated 06.02.2023 under Sections 498A/323/325/307 of
 the Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Sections 3/4 of Dowry
 Prohibition Act.
And  In the matter of: Ranjit Saha  ....petitioner.
Mr. Tapan Datta Gupta  Mr. Parvej Anam  ...for the petitioner.

Mr. Imran Ali  Ms. Debjani Sahu  ...for the State.
 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner is the husband of the informant.
3. Considered the materials placed by the learned Counsel for the parties including the statement of the witnesses and the victim.
The allegation regarding mental and physical torture and harassment is omnibus in nature.
There is no external injury on the person of the informant as found from the injury report.
4. The investigation is stated to have progressed substantially.

5. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioners, nature of allegation, substantial progress in the investigation and the fact that in a matrimonial dispute, there is always hope of compromise and unnecessary incarceration of husband or his family members frustrates such hope, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail in the event of his arrest by the Arresting Officer on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case in Connection with Mothabari Police Station Case No. 35 of 2023 dated 06.02.2023 including the condition that petitioner shall appear before the I.O.
once in a fortnight on the day and time fixed by the I.O. till the submission of Final Form.
